_comment: Adopted 2026-09-15 from the main benchweave-ui repository's memory system (see .claude/memory-protocol.md). ledger-guard.mjs rejects a malformed memory proposal in the session that can still fix it. memory-drain.mjs moves proposals into the `benchweave` MuninnDB vault (PreCompact leads because long sessions never fire SessionEnd; Stop covers crash/kill, debounced against the receipt). memory-freshness.mjs reads the drain receipt at SessionStart so a wedged or never-run drain reports itself. drain credentials: ~/.muninn/flush-keys/benchweave.token. One delta vs main: every proposal from this repo must carry the `sdk` tag (validator-enforced in memory-schema.mjs).
